final: WITH media_rates AS (SELECT m.Name AS media_type_name, AVG(1.0 * t.Bytes / t.Milliseconds) AS rate FROM MediaType AS m JOIN Track AS t ON t.MediaTypeId = m.MediaTypeId WHERE t.Bytes IS NOT NULL GROUP BY m.Name), overall AS (SELECT AVG(rate) AS average_rate FROM media_rates) SELECT media_type_name, rate, rate - average_rate AS above_average FROM media_rates CROSS JOIN overall WHERE rate > average_rate
